title: Assistant Professor
description: From July 2026, lead independent research on thermal effects over rough-wall turbulent boundary layers and large-scale flow structures in geophysical and astrophysical flows, with broad applications to environmental and geophysical fluid dynamics.
description_zh: 自 2026 年 7 月起，独立开展粗糙壁湍流边界层热效应，以及地球物理与天体物理流动中大尺度结构的研究，并广泛应用于环境与地球物理流体力学。

title: Poster – EGU General Assembly 2026
description: Presented the poster “Emergence of Robust Zonal Jets in a Differentially Heated Rotating Annulus” (EGU26-19406) at the EGU General Assembly 2026, Vienna, 3–8 May 2026. A video of the presentation is available on YouTube.
description_zh: 在 EGU General Assembly 2026（维也纳，2026 年 5 月 3–8 日）报告墙报 “Emergence of Robust Zonal Jets in a Differentially Heated Rotating Annulus”（EGU26-19406）。报告视频见 YouTube。

title: Postdoctoral Research Associate

description_zh: 在 EPSRC 项目 “Characterise flow regimes and transitions, heat transport and energy/enstrophy cascades in rapidly rotating thermal convection” 支持下，设计并搭建转速达 600 rpm 的旋转实验平台，研究斜压驱动的纬向急流。

title: Ph.D. in Physics
description: Designed and conducted PIV and numerical experiments under multiple NSFC grants, studying large-scale vortex structures, vortex dynamics, and thermal boundary layers in rotating Rayleigh-Bénard convection.
description_zh: 在多项国家自然科学基金支持下，设计并完成 PIV 与数值实验，研究旋转 Rayleigh–Bénard 对流中的大尺度涡结构、涡动力学与热边界层。
